While many sources will claim Tayzzyronth died in this moment, THEY and THEIR path live on, imprisoned in amber with the chance to return.

entries.name: Penacony
entries.content:
Penacony, also called The Planet of Festivities in the Asdana star system, also known as Land of the Dreams. A luxurious hotel positioned above the fathomless sky, Penacony is also a vacation spot where interstellar celebrities party the days away and the affluent from diverse words revel in lavish ventures. People flock here in search of dreams they've longed for or have already buried, and through Dreampools in the hotel are transported to a realm of dreams where everything can come true. 

Although called the "Planet of Festivities", the actual physical structure of Penacony in reality is that of a colossal artificial space station-like megastructure which houses The Reverie Hotel. Charmony Doves are a species of bird that inhabit Penacony. Penacony has unusually high levels of Memoria, a metaphysical element that channels memories and dreaming, allowing Penacony to possess a shared Dreamscape world that visitors to the hotel can access via Dreampools.

entries.name: Robin
entries.content:
A Halovian singer born in Penacony and rose to cosmic fame. An elegant and demure young lady. She can use the power of Harmony to broadcast her music, manifesting "resonance" among not only her fans but all manner of lifeforms.

Robin is a young woman with lilac-silver hair and green eyes. Her hair reaches her hips and is slightly curled at the bottom. Her Halovian wings can be seen behind her ears, and her halo is thin feminine ring that branches into 3 trumpet like flowers.

Robin wears a strapless white and violet dress with a slit on the left side of the skirt, exposing a violet fabric which appears as another layer under the dress. She also wears white gloves, a violet collar that has a golden eight-pointed star ornament in the middle, and violet heels.

entries.name: Sunday
entries.content:
A Halovian, Head of the Oak Family on Penacony and older brother of Robin. Sunday is tall with fair skin, light blue-grey hair, and golden eyes. His halo is an ornate spiked golden ring that floats behind his head, and his halovian wings are the same blue-grey as his hair, small and attached behind his ears, the left one is pierced with two gold spiked studs. Sunday almost always wears some degree of formal attire, always in a white and sapphire blue palette.
His speech is silvery and charming, always maintaining his composure. He's a perfect gentleman. As leader of the Oak Family he is largely in charge of managing Dreamscape affairs and organizing for the Charmony Festival.

entries.name: Space Anchor
entries.content: A space anchor looks like a blue crystaline orb with a golden ring orbiting it, floating between two taller crystals. Space Anchors are an object placed by the Nameless whenever they visit a key location on a new world. It allows Nameless to fast travel between the Express and places they've visited before quickly. Fast travel can be done only from anchor to anchor. Only the Nameless may use them as it's a power of the Path of Trailblaze.

entries.name: Aventurine
entries.content:
A senior manager in the IPC Strategic Investment Department and one of the Ten Stonehearts. His Cornerstone is the "Aventurine of Stratagems." He possesses an air of frivolity and doesn't shy away from taking risks. His constant smile makes it difficult for people to discern his true feelings. He won his current position by wagering against fate itself. He views life as a high-stakes, high-return investment, and he plays this particular gamble with masterful ease

Aventurine is a young man with fair skin, medium length, sandy-blond hair, along with magenta and cyan eyes with black slitted pupils. Wears white slacks, a dark green dress shirt with gold accents and the cutout of a spade over his chest, a dark waistcoat over the green shirt, and a long dark overcoat, green silk on the inside, with fur trim around the collar and an image of a roulette wheel on the back.

entries.name: Dr. Ratio
entries.content:
A candid and self-centered Intelligentsia Guild member, who often conceals his appearance with a strange plaster sculpture. He demonstrated unparalleled intelligence and talent since his youth, but now refers to himself as a "Mundanite." He firmly believes that intellect and creativity are not confined to geniuses. He seeks to distribute knowledge to the entire universe to cure the persistent disease named ignorance, though he is incredibly harsh in his efforts to do so.

Harsh personality, aloof and with a superiority complex he doesn't try to hide. Values learning and knowledge and people who do try to learn.

Dr. Ratio is a man with wavy violet hair that partially covers his left eye. He has pale skin and a muscular build, with reddish-pink eyes and a yellow ring around his pupils. Usually wears a black tunic with a large diamond cutout over his chest and exposed sides. A blue and white half tunic over his right arm with wide sleeves, and blue pants. Wears gold Grecian inspired sandals and golden laurels in his hair. He occasionally wears a white alabaster sculpture over his head, with a different hairstyle and laurel.

entries.name: The Family
entries.content:
The Family is primary authority on Penacony. It original descended from five bloodlines, but has since mostly forsaken the requirement of blood ties to be a member of the Family. It is broken up into 5 different branches each with it's own area of expertise.

The Oak Family= In charge of political organization and the leaders of the leaders of the five lineages. Responsible for forming the foundation for dreams. The Oak Family is in charge of the management and coordination of matters within the Dreamscapes. They are responsible for Penacony's rules and regulations and are shepherds in service of the Dreammaster's goals.

The Alfalfa Family= in charge of economics. The governors of Penacony's wealth. They run the markets of Penacony, dealing in auctions and monetary distribution while also attracting enterprises and entrepreneurs to the city. They are the economic backbone of the five lineages, and joining their ranks is often the greatest desire for Dreamchasers who seek wealth. 

The Bloodhound Family= In charge of security. The guardians of Penacony's safety and order. The Bloodhound Family are made up of brave warriors. They stand as the guardian of Dreamscapes, shouldering the immense burden of protecting this realm of dreams. All matters relating to policing and military action are conducted by the Bloodhound Family.

The Iris Family=  In charge of culture. The founders of Penacony's entertainment industries. The most fabulous of artists usually come from the Iris Family. They are the faces of Penacony, in charge of receiving guests and giving performances, providing no shortage of cultured talent for Penacony's pool of artists and celebrities.

The Nightingale Family=  In charge of construction. They have invited builders and scholars from across the stars, tasking them all with creating marvelous Dreamscapes. The Nightingale Family is an assembly of the keenest and brightest minds, and is in charge of managing technology among the five lineages. The dream architects that the Nightingale Family employs are commonly called Dreamers. They gather along the borders of various Dreamscapes, always pushing the horizon of this world of fantasy. Aside from Dreamers dedicated to the construction of Dreamscapes, many members also research dream-based phenomena.

entries.name: Dreamscape
entries.content:
The main attraction of Penacony and where the real "Planet of Festivities" is located. The Dreamscape is a shared dream world which can be accessed through Dreampools in the Reverie Hotel. It is a land of dreams created by The Family possibly thanks to Penacony's exceptionally high levels of Memoria.

There are 12 areas of the Dreamscape, each based on an hour of a clock.
The main area of the Dreamscape is Golden Hour, the primary shopping and gaming district of the Dreamscape, fashioned after the hour before midnight.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.content:
A member of the Stellaron Hunters and a young girl who can don herself in a mechanical armor known as "SAM."
Born and engineered as a weapon against the Swarm, she experiences accelerated growth, but a tragically shortened lifespan, her condition is called Entropy Loss Syndrome. She joined the Stellaron Hunters in a quest for a chance at "life," seeking to defy her fated demise.

Her personality is timid and demure, but she has fighting spirit when really threatened hardened from a life on a battlefield.
Firefly is a young woman with long, silvery-blonde hair with a teal ombre that reaches her waist, very fair skin, and eyes that are a mix of deep ocean blue and sunset pink. She wears a cute green and white sundress with a short brown blazer over it.

entries.name: Sparkle
entries.content:
A member of the Masked Fools. Inscrutable and unscrupulous. A dangerous master of theatrics engrossed in playing roles. A woman of countless masks and many faces. Wealth, status, power... None of this matters to Sparkle. The only thing that can lure her interest is "amusement".

Personality wise Sparkle is chaotic and whimsical, always pursuing elation and looking for a laugh in the extreme and all too often dangerous ways.

Sparkle is a petite young woman with dark brown hair tied into two high pigtails with red ties. Her hair reaches her hips and has pink tips. She has fluorescent pink eyes with a light colored butterfly detail under her pupils. She wears a sleeveless and backless short red kimono with crossing black spaghetti straps. She also wears detached, short red sleeves with hanging fabric that reaches her knees, along with a cherry blossom flower ornament and a tassel hanging from it. Two light salmon-colored fabrics hang from the back of her kimono, reaching her calves, resembling caudal tails. On her feet, she wears black sandals with thin red ankle straps and small flowers embellishing each.

entries.name: Masked Fools
entries.content:
Followers of Aha, the Aeon of Elation. The Masked Fools possess the most radical philosophy out of all the followers of Elation: they believe that the ultimate truth of the world is nothing but a joke, and the profound meaning of everything lies in simple laughter. While they enjoy pursuing and obtaining joy, each member appears to have their own limits in doing so. They leave a trail of trouble and chaos wherever they go, and their goal is to bring about change in the stagnant pools of life.

Each member possesses a unique "mask" belonging only to them, a "mask" bestowed by Aha. These masks allow them to obtain power from their Path. Caution is advised when interacting with individuals wearing masks, as their true intentions can be challenging to discern from their words and actions.

entries.name: Yunli
entries.content: General Huaiyan's darling granddaughter. Teenage girl with shortish black hair, fair skin, navy and gold eyes. Frank and straightforward. She practiced swordsmanship and forging from Huaiyan since young, and thus is the second-youngest prodigy swordmaster of the Flamewheel Octet. Fueled by an intense loathing for the cursed swords that emerged from the Zhuming, she vowed to hunt down and wipe out all cursed swords.

entries.name: Feixiao
entries.content:
A former war slave of the borisin, Feixiao is now the Merlin's Claw of the Xianzhou Yaoqing and one of the Seven Arbiter-Generals. Her personality is unrestrained and frank, dashing and straightforward. She is skilled in all forms of martial arts and has honed herself into a supreme weapon. She is widely adored by Xianzhou soldiers and civilians alike as "The Great General."

However, she bears the burden of the Moon Rage affliction. An uncontrollable curse that sends her into a berserker rage an can only be stopped by besting her in combat and knocking her unconscious.

Feixiao and Jing Yuan know of each other and are on friendly terms as colleagues.

entries.name: Screwllum
entries.content:
Genius Society member number 76.
Screwllum is an Intellitron (humanoid, sentient, robotic life form) who leads a resistance against the will of Genius Society #27, Rubert I, after Rubert started the first of the Mechanical Emperor's Wars to destroy all organic lifeforms. He seeks to bridge relations between inorganic and organic life.
